audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] says 'R Fear Beyond Death can't be parried once it flips her', and whys[4]/mid call the R 'unparriable'. This is backwards and it is the most dangerous line on the page.
audit.why: Riot's Riposte text: she parries all incoming damage, then stabs — and the stab STUNS if she blocked an immobilizing effect with it. Fear Beyond Death is an impale and Disdain is a flip; both are exactly the immobilise that upgrades her parry into a stun on you. Throwing either into an available Riposte hands her the fight.
audit.corrected: The unparriable claim removed everywhere and replaced with the real sequencing: bait the 24s Riposte first, then spend Disdain or R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows read Skill. The mirror set this lane as Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Skill / Urgot / Urgot / Urgot, and this page's own whys[5] additionally hands First item back to Fiora, contradicting it.
audit.why: The mirror was audited first and flipped the whole chart deliberately; the two directions must agree. 53.77% over 956 games fits a lane Fiora owns early and Urgot takes from 6 onward.
audit.corrected: Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Skill / Urgot / Urgot / Urgot with matching win[N] rows and ratings; whys[5], spikes[2] and late rewritten so First item argues for Urgot instead of against.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte is the tracked cooldown on every screen and its number is nowhere on the page; Lunge's is missing too.
audit.why: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 — the longest gap Fiora has, and the whole basis for 'bait it'. Lunge is 13s at rank 1, Grand Challenge 110s.
audit.corrected: 24s and 13s written into the phases, spikes, mid and the cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds advice against Fiora, and report[8] calls her 'his'.
audit.why: Duelist's Dance restores health on every Vital she strikes and Grand Challenge heals her and nearby allies on a completed set — anti-heal timing decides every extended trade. Lunge also applies on-hit effects, so armour alone misreads the trade.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds tied to the Vital healing in spikes[0], whys[5] and late; the pronoun fixed.

notes: The worst line on this page told the reader Fear Beyond Death cannot be parried. Riot's Riposte text is the opposite: it parries all incoming damage and the follow-up stab stuns if it blocked an immobilizing effect — which is precisely what Disdain's flip and the R impale are.
